strategy.summary: The todo app (public/app.js, client-side in-memory state) lets users tick todos complete, filter All/Active/Completed (aria-pressed on the selected filter button) and clear completed todos. Tests drive the real static server (started by Playwright's existing webServer) in Chromium and prove each acceptance criterion through user-visible state: strike-through, the "N items left" text, the visible list items, aria-pressed, and the Clear completed button's visibility.
inScope: Completing and un-completing a todo (strike-through and items-left count)
Active/Completed/All filters and their pressed state
outOfScope: Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos only in memory; the ticket does not ask for it)
assumptions: The real app runs: Playwright's existing webServer starts `node server.js` on port 4173; nothing is faked (there is no backend API).
Todos live in page memory, so each test starts from an empty list on a fresh page and creates its own todos through the UI; no cross-test cleanup is needed.
"Struck through" is verified as the computed text-decoration-line of the todo's text being line-through (and none once unticked), since that is what the user sees.
"Pressed" means aria-pressed="true" on the selected filter button and "false" on the others.

risks.description: Count text pluralisation (1 item / 2 items) wrong after toggling
risks.mitigation: TC1/TC2 assert exact count text both ways across the 1/2 boundary

risks.description: Clear completed removes active todos too, or only one completed todo
risks.mitigation: TC7 completes two of three todos and asserts exactly the active one remains

risks.description: Filter shows wrong set or pressed state not updated
risks.mitigation: TC3-TC5 assert exact visible list and aria-pressed for all three buttons

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed: it is struck through and the "items left" count goes down by one; unticking it reverses both.
The Active filter shows only todos that aren't completed, Completed only those that are, All shows every todo, and the selected filter is shown as pressed.
"Clear completed" appears only while a todo is completed, and removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements the items left count
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox is checked, its text has text-decoration-line line-through, 'Walk dog' is not struck through, count reads '1 item left'

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores the items left count
steps: Tick 'Buy milk' and assert '1 item left'
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, text-decoration-line is none, count reads '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that are not completed and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Buy milk', 'Pay rent']; Active aria-pressed true, All and Completed false
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Walk dog']; Completed aria-pressed true, All and Active false
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again after another filter and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List shows ['Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent']; All aria-pressed true, Active and Completed false
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent
testCases.rationale: Returning to All restores the full list

testCases.title: Clear completed is shown only while a todo is completed
steps: Add 'Buy milk'; assert list has it and Clear completed is hidden
Tick 'Buy milk'; assert Clear completed visible
testCases.expected: Clear completed hidden with only active todos, visible once one is completed, hidden again after unticking
testCases.rationale: The 'only while' half of AC3, including the refusal-like absent state

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Walk dog'], count '1 item left', Clear completed hidden
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent
testCases.rationale: Removes every completed todo, not just one, and not active ones

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright's webServer in playwright.config.js starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (BASE_URL http://localhost:4173). Chromium only. No seed data or env vars.
